    Linear Fubini equivalences for residual orbit flattening #

    For a normal subgroup N ◁ G, multiplication identifies (G / N) × N with G after choosing the canonical quotient representatives. This file lifts that bijection to the homogeneous shifted Hom spaces and their finite-support direct sums. It also records the corresponding formula for the actual residual flattening functor on a doubly homogeneous generator.
